About Us

One of the company's greatest goals is to expose our dancers to professional and challenging choreography. Each semester, we bring in guest choreographers to set pieces on our dancers. Past choreographers and teachers include Ada Brightwater, Tomas Elling, and Rhea Calder. In past performances, we have invited alumni Nora Vance (2010), Piet Harlow (2010), and Juno Sato (2014) to create original works on our company.

We are a contemporary dance group that welcomes a wide variety of dance styles and backgrounds, and we are dedicated to creating and supporting innovative student choreography and performance in an inclusive environment.
